verdict.rationale: The evidence names outside parties in the protocols Stripe backs. OpenAI implements ACP in ChatGPT, and ACP is Apache 2.0 so any agent or payment processor can implement it. MPP is co-authored with Tempo, has a public spec, Tempo ships its own CLI that can pay, and a community post says it was submitted to the IETF. Stripe also supports x402 and UCP. However, both named parties are co-developers or launch partners rather than clearly independent adopters, and no third-party seller, agent or PSP is shown implementing ACP or MPP; missing for 10: evidence of at least two genuinely independent implementers beyond Stripe and its co-authors, and independent confirmation of ecosystem adoption.
